title: Canonical signed total tensor stalk comparison and chain naturality
statement:
Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $A$ a commutative ring, and $\bar t:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to T$ a geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point]. Use the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], the constant ring sheaf $A_T$ [def-kun-constant-sheaf], and the module-valued stalk $S(F)=F_{\bar t}$ [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]. For unbounded cochain complexes $C,D$ of $A_T$-module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category], tensor means the direct-sum total tensor [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves], also for ordinary $A$-module complexes: degree $n$ is $\bigoplus_{p+q=n}C^p\otimes D^q$ and the differential on bidegree $(p,q)$ is $d_C\otimes1+(-1)^p1\otimes d_D$. There is a unique natural chain isomorphism
$$\theta_{C,D}:S(C\otimes_{A_T}D)\xrightarrow{\sim}SC\otimes_A SD$$
with the following normalization. If $p+q=n$, $\iota_{p,q}$ is the source total-complex coprojection, $\iota'_{p,q}$ the target coprojection, and $\gamma_{M,N}:S(M\otimes_{A_T}N)\to SM\otimes_A SN$ the ordinary tensor comparison for $A_T$-module sheaves $M,N$, characterized by $\gamma((s\otimes t)_{\bar t})=s_{\bar t}\otimes t_{\bar t}$ for sections on a common pointed etale neighbourhood, then
$$\theta_{C,D}^n\circ S(\iota_{p,q})=\iota'_{p,q}\circ\gamma_{C^p,D^q}.$$
For every pair of chain maps $f:C\to C'$, $g:D\to D'$ one has
$$\theta_{C',D'}\circ S(f\otimes g)=(Sf\otimes Sg)\circ\theta_{C,D}.$$
No boundedness or termwise flatness is required; totalization uses the countable coproducts indexed by $p+q=n$, not products.

proof.text: Let S be the lifted geometric-point sheaf fiber with coefficients in A-modules. Its existing strong monoidal structure supplies the canonical oplax tensor comparison delta and its invertibility. The skyscraper sheaf adjunction makes S preserve coproducts; the proved Point.sheafFiber_additive lemma supplies additivity. These are the generic interfaces used below, without converting through abelian sheaves.

For each pair C,D, take asIso of HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctorComparison applied to Functor.OplaxMonoidal.deltaNatTrans S and ComplexShape.up Z. The existing source-library construction descends the ordinary comparison from the total-tensor coproduct summands, checks the two signed differential terms using additivity and naturality, and constructs the inverse from the inverse ordinary comparisons. Its map_ιMapBifunctor_mapBifunctorComparisonX equation gives exactly the required normalization. The strong monoidal structure makes each component and hence this chain comparison invertible.

Apply the proved HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctorComparison_naturality to the two chain maps f and g. This is the required simultaneous naturality equation, with the same signed total tensor on both sides.

For any other normalized family, use function extensionality in C,D, Iso.ext, and chain-map extensionality degree by degree. HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctor.hom_ext_of_map says it suffices to precompose with S of every total-tensor coprojection. The two normalization equations have identical right hand sides, so their transitive equality proves uniqueness. The construction uses the same direct-sum totalization for arbitrary unbounded complexes and imposes no flatness hypothesis.
